Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Provisioning and maintaining user accounts, group assignments, and directory memberships across identity platforms. Authorization & Access Control (AWS & GitLab): Managing fine-grained permission models, roles, and group memberships within AWS IAM Identity Center (IDC) and GitLab repositories/groups. ROLE OVERVIEW In this role, you’ll develop machine learning capabilities for Echodyne radars and data systems. You’ll work with radar data to enhance our labeling process and improve how our systems detect, classify, and track targets in complex, changing environments. You’ll own work from data exploration and model prototyping through evaluation and production deployment. You’ll make practical tradeoffs among accuracy, latency, computation, and reliability. Your work will have a direct impact on our advanced data systems and growing fleet of fielded radars, helping make them more robust and effective at protecting the infrastructure and people that rely on them in an evolving world. RESPONSIBILITIES Prioritize and ensure real-world robustness and zero-regression deployment of models to our fleet of fielded radars. Improve the accuracy and capacity of our data labeling systems by developing active learning methods and automated labeling systems, and by advising on tool design. Design data augmentation methods that reflect realistic variation in radar deployment environments. Improve existing track-classification models through hyper-parameter tuning and trading alternative architectures. Research and develop new applications of machine learning to improve our systems, such as self-supervised generative models utilizing our extensive unlabeled data. jobs.description_text: Echodyne is seeking a Software Engineering Manager , Data Platform, to join our fast-growing team. As Engineering Manager, Data Platform, you will lead the team responsible for building and operating the services, data flows, and interfaces that connect these environments. jobs.description_text: Echodyne is seeking a Tool Crib Coordinator to support our manufacturing operations. ROLE OVERVIEW As a Tool Crib Coordinator, you will help keep production and maintenance teams equipped with the tools they need. jobs.title: Information Security Engineer
jobs.description_text: What You'll Do At Edmentum, security is the foundation that keeps student data, educator tools, and the platforms behind learning for millions of students safe. As an Information Security Engineer, you'll get hands-on with the systems and practices that protect them. You'll work alongside talented Technology teams to strengthen our security posture, sharpen your skills across security operations and compliance, and help bring new tools, including AI, into how we defend Edmentum. In this role you will: Monitor production systems for security events, take part in incident response, and help keep Edmentum's data and infrastructure secure and available. Run vulnerability assessments, drive remediation, and apply proven risk frameworks to close security gaps. Support compliance with FERPA, COPPA, GDPR, NIST, and SOC 2, helping keep Edmentum audit-ready. Evaluate and administer security tools, and explore emerging technologies, including AI, to strengthen our defenses. Partner with development, systems, and network teams to build security into how we build and operate. Improve change management, configuration management, and security metrics, and help find root causes after incidents. Who You Are You have 3 to 5 years of experience supporting and securing enterprise IT infrastructure, ideally in a SaaS environment. jobs.title: Manager, Applied AI Research
jobs.description_text: What You'll Do AI is changing what educational technology can do for students, and the question of whether it actually works for learners is one the whole field is still figuring out. At Edmentum, we think that question deserves real evidence. As Manager, Applied AI Research, you will lead the team that produces it. You will design the studies that test whether our AI-enabled features are reliable, valid, and fair, and you will carry those findings into the rooms where product and policy decisions get made. Your work will shape both what we build and how the broader education community understands responsible AI in the classroom. In this role you will: Lead a team of researchers producing rigorous, defensible evidence on the reliability, validity, and fairness of Edmentum's AI-enabled features. Design and oversee research and validation approaches for automated scoring, algorithmic decision support, and emerging AI capabilities. Represent Edmentum in academic, industry, standards-body, customer, and policy-facing forums, and build our external credibility on responsible AI. Partner with Product Management, Technology, Learning and Assessment Design, and Efficacy Research to shape the questions that matter and deliver answers on the timelines that matter. Help set the AI research agenda alongside senior research leadership, then turn those priorities into a clear plan of work for your team. Hire, coach, and develop researchers, and build a team that grows as fast as the field

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description_text: As we continue to grow across Minnesota, we're proactively building a strong pipeline of Sales Development Representative talent. This posting is designed to connect us with individuals who are interested in future opportunities and ready to make an impact when positions become available. What You'll Do Ready to launch your sales career at the intersection of technology and education?
